units.source_text: 且说夕雾回思柏木困窘不堪而隐约说出的那番话，

en.t: Now Yugiri thought back on those words Kashiwagi had faintly spoken in unbearable distress,

units.source_text: 想道：“到底是怎么一回事呢？

en.t: and wondered, "What on earth was it all about?

units.source_text: 如果他那时神志再清爽些，

en.t: If his mind had been a little clearer then,

units.source_text: 也许会把真情说出，我就可察知究竟了。

en.t: he might have told me the truth, and I could have understood what had really happened.

units.source_text: 但那是无可挽救的弥留之际，

en.t: But that was his final hour, when nothing could be done to save him,

units.source_text: 真不凑巧，教人好不懊丧，真是遗恨无穷啊！”

en.t: and the timing was so unfortunate that it fills me with regret; the bitterness of it will never end!"

units.source_text: 他始终不能忘记柏木当时的面影，

en.t: He could never forget Kashiwagi's face at that time,

units.source_text: 比柏木的诸弟更加悲伤。

en.t: and he grieved even more deeply than Kashiwagi's own younger brothers.

units.source_text: 又想：“三公主此次并无何等沉重的疾病，

en.t: He also thought, "The Third Princess was not suffering from any very serious illness this time,

units.source_text: 而毅然决然地出家为尼，又是什么道理呢？

en.t: so why did she so firmly resolve to leave the world and become a nun?

units.source_text: 即使她自愿出家，父亲难道会允许她么？

en.t: Even if she herself wished to take vows, would Father really have allowed it?

units.source_text: 上次紫夫人病势那么危笃，

en.t: When Lady Murasaki's illness was so grave the other day,

units.source_text: 啼啼哭哭地要求出家，

en.t: she wept and begged to become a nun,

units.source_text: 父亲尚且不肯抛舍，终于将她留住了。

en.t: yet Father still could not bear to let her go, and in the end kept her with him.

units.source_text: 综合起来仔细想想，

en.t: When I put everything together and think it over carefully,

units.source_text: 恐怕还是因为柏木自昔恋慕三公主，

en.t: it was probably because Kashiwagi had loved the Third Princess since long ago,

units.source_text: 一直不曾断念，苦闷难忍之时，不免有所流露。

en.t: and had never given her up; when his anguish became unbearable, something of it must have slipped out.

units.source_text: 柏木为人非常沉着，

en.t: Kashiwagi was by nature very composed,

units.source_text: 外表看来，比常人特别温厚周谨。

en.t: and outwardly he seemed especially gentle, kind, and cautious, more so than most people.

units.source_text: 别人要知道他心中所思何事，

en.t: For others to know what he was thinking in his heart

units.source_text: 实在困难得很。

en.t: was truly very difficult.

units.source_text: 然而他的意志稍稍薄弱，

en.t: Yet his will was somewhat weak,

units.source_text: 情感过分温柔，这就难免错失。

en.t: and his feelings were too tender; because of that, mistakes were hard to avoid.

units.source_text: 恋情无论何等痛苦，

en.t: No matter how painful love may be,

units.source_text: 在不该做的事情上迷乱心情，

en.t: to let one's heart be confused by something one ought not do,

units.source_text: 以致失却性命，决非长策。

en.t: and even lose one's life because of it, is certainly no wise course.

units.source_text: 给对方招来痛苦，自己又徒然丧身，如何使得！

en.t: To bring suffering on the other person and then vainly destroy oneself as well, how could that ever be right!

units.source_text: 虽说是前世注定的因缘，

en.t: Even if one says it was a bond destined from a former life,

units.source_text: 毕竟过分轻率，真乃无聊之事！”

en.t: in the end it was far too reckless, truly a foolish thing!"

units.source_text: 他心中如此想，

en.t: He thought this in his heart,

units.source_text: 但对夫人云居雁也不诉说。

en.t: but he did not speak of it even to his wife, Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 对父亲源氏，因无适当机会，亦不曾禀告。

en.t: Nor did he report it to his father Genji, because no suitable opportunity arose.

units.source_text: 但他总想把柏木隐约吐露的事告诉父亲，

en.t: Still, he kept wanting to tell his father what Kashiwagi had hinted at,

units.source_text: 看他有何表示。

en.t: and see what response he would show.
